md2html

Converts Markdown to HTML. It handles the parts of CommonMark that most README files use.

Install

  1. Install Loup:

    curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh

  2. Build:

    make build

Usage

Option Meaning
-o FILE write to FILE
-s a whole page

Note: raw HTML such as <script> is escaped.

  • Fast enough
  • Small: about 2,000 lines of Loup
  • Tested against a golden corpus
